aboutGame.title: What is Jujutsu School Anomaly?
paragraphs: Jujutsu School Anomaly is a suspenseful psychological horror inspection game on Roblox set within the supernatural halls of Tokyo Jujutsu High. Taking on the graveyard shift at the school perimeter, your mission is to verify visitor identification cards, validate official permits, and preserve the defensive cursed barrier protecting students and staff from invading curses.

Drawing inspiration from anomaly observation classics like The Exit 8, the game challenges players across escalating night shifts to detect subtle distortions, unmask shape-shifting impostors, and confront high-grade cursed entities. Every detail matters: mistaking an anomaly for a genuine student or overlooking a forged seal will trigger catastrophic resets.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Essential questions and answers about surviving and progressing in Jujutsu School Anomaly.

items.question: What is Jujutsu School Anomaly on Roblox?
items.answer: Jujutsu School Anomaly is a psychological horror inspection survival game on Roblox where players work night shifts inspecting visitors and protecting the cursed barrier at Jujutsu High.

items.question: How do you detect anomalies in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: In Jujutsu School Anomaly, you detect anomalies by cross-referencing visitor identification cards, checking expiration dates, verifying official stamps, and watching for unnatural facial expressions or physical distortions.

items.question: How many shifts are there in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Jujutsu School Anomaly features sequential night shifts (Shifts 1 through 8) that challenge your observation skills with increasingly deceptive supernatural entities.

items.question: Are there working promo codes for Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Active codes for Jujutsu School Anomaly provide free in-game boosts, cosmetics, and flashlight battery refills; check our dedicated codes section regularly for new developer drops.

items.question: How do you unlock the true ending in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: To achieve the true ending in Jujutsu School Anomaly, you must complete all shift inspections without error, gather secret documents, and successfully repel the final boss encounter.

items.question: What happens if you approve an anomaly in Jujutsu School Anomaly?
items.answer: Approving an impostor in Jujutsu School Anomaly weakens the protective school barrier, causes immediate power surges, and can trigger a fatal jumpscare that resets your shift progress.
